pick.headline: Croatian forces take Knin
pick.fbis: The East Europe Daily Report of August 7, 1995, carried AFP on UN mediator Stoltenberg shuttling between Belgrade and Zagreb as Croatia shelled Knin, and Belgrade TANJUG accusing Washington of giving "direct support" to Croatian aggression; the fall of Knin is not on this page.
